resident of Nalgonda came to the hospital with\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS:\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInvoluntary movements of\u0026nbsp; upper limbs since 4 years\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EStiffness of all 4 limbs since 4 years\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESlowness of movements since 4 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInvoluntary movements of lower limbs since 3 years\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 4 years back then he developed involuntary movements which developed in right upper limb since 4 years and after 6 months of initiation of right side developed to Left upper limb which was gradual in onset, occurs at rest\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Esince 3 years developed\u0026nbsp; in lower limbs also which were subsided by voluntary movements and also subsides during sleep as told by family href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6318091\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6318091\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EP: Double blinded study\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E8 RCT were done among which 2 included early Parkinsons disease patients\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDeep brain stimulation\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDBS of any kind (i.e., unilateral or bilateral; any target area) was compared to BMT.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBetween Deep brain stimulation and the medical management.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EO:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOutcome measures were impairment\/disability using the Unified Parkinson’s Disease Rating Scale (UPDRS), quality of life (QoL) using the Parkinson's Disease Questionnaire (PDQ-39), levodopa equivalent dose (LED) reduction, and rates of serious adverse events (SAE).\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere was a significantly greater reduction of Levodopa equivalent dose in patients with early PD (P \u0026lt; 0.00001), but no other differences between early and advanced PD patients were found.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDBS was superior to Best medical therapy at improving impairment\/disability, Quality of life and reducing medication doses.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2)Efficacy and safety of topical and systemic medications: a systematic literature review informing the EULAR recommendations for the management of Sjögren’s syndrome\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6827762\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6827762\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EP: Double blinded study\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E120 patients of primary sjogrens were taken were taken for randomised control trial\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOral Hydroxychloroquine vs placebo\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECompared between 56 ppl who has taken 400mg\/day of hydroxychloroquine and 64 ppl taken as placebo.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EO:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPrimary Outcomes measured in terms of VAS scores (dryness,fatigue,pain) at 24weeks\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E30% reduction of 2 symptoms at 24 weeks (among both groups,with no statistical significance)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eone of the secondary outcomes, hydroxychloroquine was associated with a statistical trend to improved pain (p values between 0.06 and 0.10 at 12, 24 and 48 weeks) although it was not superior to Placebo for articular involvement.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo statistical differences were found in response to fatigue.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr None of his family members, have hearing loss .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;She started working from from age of 14 years , used to work in farm , wakes up at 5 am\u0026nbsp; does her daily activities, and prepared food for her and her family members, eats rice and curry then go to farm and in afternoon she again takes rice and curry, after her work she returns home at 4pm , and she does the household works like sweeping floor , washing clothes and cleaning the utensils and by 9pm everyone will have dinner and goes to sleep by 10 pm . This was her routine till 40 years of age , after that his son got married and after his son had children stopped working to take care of of her grand children. After her son's marriage, she does only evening household works as both her son and daughter -in -law goes to work .
